logical_fallacies.example: Asserting ice cream consumption causes drowning because both increase in summer.
logical_fallacies.text: Elon Musk claiming that the majority of deaths during the pandemic were caused by ventilators and not COVID itself.

logical_fallacies.example: Believing a lucky charm caused winning a game.
logical_fallacies.text: The argument that putting COVID-19 patients on ventilators caused their deaths because they were placed on ventilators before dying.

logical_fallacies.example: Concluding all dogs are aggressive based on encountering a few aggressive dogs.
logical_fallacies.text: The statement that most COVID-19 patients placed on ventilators died, without considering other factors.

logical_fallacies.example: Comparing internet content regulation to book censorship without acknowledging differences.
logical_fallacies.text: Comparing the use of ventilators for COVID-19 patients with a death sentence without considering the medical context.

logical_fallacies.example: Shifting the debate on climate change to economic costs without addressing environmental impacts.
logical_fallacies.text: Distracting from the main issue of COVID-19 deaths by focusing on the use of ventilators as the cause.
